Добавить проверки, которые не позволят проекту снова разойтись с Конституцией.

## Architecture guards

Запрещать:

```text
client-specific parser
projectId branching inside adapter
direct fetch outside Safe Outbound
raw Prisma row → public snapshot
sourceUrl → public inventory media
private fields → public datasets
```

## Snapshot guards

```text
13 canonical datasets required
privacy projection required
referential integrity required
signature required
publishSequence monotonic
```

## Runtime guards

CI должен ловить ситуацию:

```text
module exists
but production composition absent
```

Для ключевых capabilities нужны smoke tests через реальные public application entrypoints.

---
Out of scope: new CI policy; guards run inside project manual exact-head Gate, not on push/PR.
acceptance_criteria: Architecture guards reject client/project parser branching/direct unsafe fetch/raw Prisma/source URLs/private fields; snapshot enforces 13 datasets/privacy/integrity/signature/monotonic sequence; runtime smoke detects missing composition.

required_checks: Focused negative fixtures for each forbidden dependency/projection
